findings.current: He also knew that those three words included one being who was more human than most humans.
findings.defect: “Everyone” is one English word, not three; the count refers to the three Korean syllables of ‘사람들.’
findings.rationale: The replacement preserves the inclusion without carrying over an inapplicable Korean syllable count.
findings.replacement: He also knew that Jin’s request included one being who was more human than most humans.
findings.source:
그가 말하는 ‘사람들’이 정확히 누구를 칭하는 것인지, 최민우는 이미 충분히 짐작하고 있었다.

대부분의 인간보다도 더욱 인간 같은, 어느 한 존재 역시 저 세 글자에 포함되어 있다는 사실 역시도.

findings.current: The instruction manual for that ancient capsule, the starting point of all this, said a Player remained bound to it permanently, until death.
findings.defect: The draft makes the Player bound to the capsule; the manual says the capsule is permanently bound to its Player until the Player dies.
findings.rationale: The attachment rule concerns the capsule and its owner.
findings.replacement: The instruction manual for that beat-up old capsule, the starting point of all this, said it remained permanently bound to its Player until the Player died.
findings.source: 이 모든 것의 시작이라 할 수 있는 그 낡아빠진 캡슐 이용 설명서에는, 플레이어의 사망 전까지 영구 귀속된다고 적혀 있었으니까.

findings.current: Just as Taishan moves and leaves his mark, every choice you make will affect the whole world.
findings.defect: The draft treats 태산 as the character Taishan. Here it is a great mountain in a simile about the consequences of movement.
findings.rationale: The mountain image parallels the worldwide impact of the Player’s choices.
findings.replacement: Just as a great mountain leaves its mark when it moves, every choice you make will affect the whole world.
findings.source: 태산이 움직이며 흔적을 남기듯, 당신의 모든 선택 역시 온 세상에 영향을 끼칠 것입니다.

findings.current: Friends who’d gladly lay down their lives for me.
findings.defect: The draft reverses who is willing to die: Jin would lay down his life for these friends.
findings.rationale: The implied subject of 기꺼이 목숨을 내놓을만한 is the first-person narrator.
findings.replacement: Friends I’d gladly lay down my life for.
findings.source: 등을 맡길 수 있는 전우이자, 기꺼이 목숨을 내놓을만한 친구이며, 이제는 가족이라 불러도 좋을 그들을 향해 나는 첫 마디를 뗐다.

findings.current: Just like those hurried footsteps I could clearly hear beyond the countless layers of magic covering this place.
findings.defect: The source says Jin can distinctly sense the footsteps, not necessarily hear them through the magical barriers.
findings.rationale: 느껴지는 describes perception without specifying hearing.
findings.replacement: Just like those hurried footsteps I could clearly sense beyond the countless layers of magic covering this place.
findings.source: 이 공간을 뒤덮은 무수한 마법의 막 너머로, 선명하게 느껴지는 저 다급한 발걸음들처럼.

findings.defect: The Undead King asks whether Jin is still half asleep, not whether he slept enough.
findings.rationale: 잠이 덜 깨다 means not yet fully awake; the line responds to Jin’s apparently dreamlike proposal.

findings.current: “By the time they tied you to the stake, you would’ve been. They’d just have to remove what you’ve got between your legs.”
findings.defect: The draft replaces the speaker’s dangling-thing euphemism with a more anatomically explicit location.
findings.rationale: 아랫도리에 달린 것 preserves the crude but indirect joke.
findings.replacement: “By the time they tied you to the stake, you would’ve been. They’d just have to cut off what’s dangling down there.”
findings.source: “화형대에 매달렸을 때쯤이면 여자가 되어 있을걸? 아랫도리에 달린 것만 떼면 되잖아.”

findings.current:
—There are System messages you haven’t checked.

—The distribution and density of [magical power] are skyrocketing…

—Current progress of the [rift]…
findings.defect: These consecutive System notices are not framed as a System window, and the UI terms retain source-style square brackets.
findings.rationale: The binding format calls for one blockquoted System window for consecutive notices, without square brackets around UI terms.
findings.replacement:
> **System**
>
> —There are System messages you haven’t checked.
>
> —The distribution and density of magical power are skyrocketing…
>
> —Current progress of the rift…
findings.source:
- 확인하지 못한 시스템 메시지가 있습니다.

- [마력]의 분포도와 농도가 폭등…….

- [균열]의 현재 진행도…….

findings.current:
—Quest success requirements have not been met.

—Main Quest, [Rift and Collapse], has failed.

—A new Main Quest, [The Foreordained Collapse], has been created.

—Would you like to view this Quest? Y / N
findings.defect: A second group of consecutive System notices is unframed and retains square brackets around Quest names.
findings.rationale: The prose between the two notice groups requires a separate System window.
findings.replacement:
> **System**
>
> —Quest success requirements have not been met.
>
> —Main Quest, Rift and Collapse, has failed.
>
> —A new Main Quest, The Foreordained Collapse, has been created.
>
> —Would you like to view this Quest? Y / N
findings.source:
- 퀘스트 성공 요건을 충족하지 못했습니다.

- 메인 퀘스트, [균열과 붕괴]가 실패했습니다.

- 새로운 메인 퀘스트, [예정된 붕괴]가 생성되었습니다.

- 해당 퀘스트를 확인하시겠습니까? Y / N

findings.defect: The Quest title retains square brackets inside the framed System panel.
findings.rationale: The System heading and blockquote already identify this as UI text.

summary: The draft is broadly faithful, but it reverses a sacrifice, misreads a mountain metaphor as a character reference, and leaves two System windows unformatted.
